whyUntracked: they hold thousands of unreviewed synopses about named people. The privacy guarantee is the ABSENCE of the bytes rather than a permission check: .gitignore keeps them out of the repository and vite.config.ts serves them to the editorial dev server only.
theRealDefect: the skip was SILENT. The audit emitted 216 invariants, reported "216/216 pass", and overwrote the certified 222-invariant report with the shorter one — so anyone running it in a fresh worktree quietly downgraded a certified artifact while every number still looked perfect. It is also why the earlier full-validation receipt tree did not match the committed tree: the validator’s own audit step rewrote the artifact underneath it.
fix: a skipped invariant is recorded rather than omitted, and named on stdout with the reason
